Nina (People Ops): Heads-up: we're publishing an updated handbook section for data handling and vendor access. Mandatory refresh training will be scheduled next month. Please read the draft and acknowledge by end of week.
Tom (Legal): Draft posted here: https://handbook.redwood.com/security/vendor-access-update -- comments welcome. Focused on least-privilege and vendor onboard checklist.
Keisha (Eng): Does the new policy change third-party SSH/key access for contractors?
Tom (Legal): Short answer: yes. Contractors must use ephemeral keys via our bastion; permanent keys require an exception.
Nina (People Ops): We'll add a short FAQ about exceptions in the handbook page.
training-bot: New course created: "2026 Data Handling & Vendor Access Refresher" — enrollments open. Deadline to complete: 2026-05-28.
Carlos (People Ops): Enrollment link: https://learning.redwood.com/courses/data-vendor-2026. Please complete the quick quiz at the end; pass rate required is 80%.
Jon (Finance): Heads-up for managers: completion status will be included in next month's compliance report for budgets.
Keisha (Eng): If I'm on parental leave during rollout, can I complete later? Asking for a teammate.
Nina (People Ops): Yes — we have a deferral process. Managers should file a deferral request via people-ops@redwood.com and cc hr-bot.
training-bot: Reminder: initial auto-enroll sent to all full-time and contractor employees 2026-05-01.
Tom (Legal): Please focus comments on section 3 (vendor onboarding), section 5 (data retention), and section 8 (audit logs). We'll lock the doc Wednesday.
Carlos (People Ops): We'll run a 30-min optional office hour next Friday 10:00 PT to walk through the changes.
Keisha (Eng): Thanks, will join office hour.
Nina (People Ops): Final note: ack in the handbook will count as confirmation of reading. We'll also track training completion for auditors.
